families.label: MD5
families.selection_note: Full MD5 is already broken. Steps 63/64 are explicit reproduction/improvement controls, an exception to the first-unbroken rule.

families.label: SHA-1
families.selection_note: Full SHA-1 is already broken. Rounds 79/80 are explicit reproduction/improvement controls, an exception to the first-unbroken rule.

families.label: SHA-256
families.selection_note: User-selected ordinary-collision frontier experiment at rounds 31/32; literature boundaries must match the complete padded hash and charged time-memory model.

families.label: Keccak[1600] / SHA3-256
families.selection_note: SHA3-256 sponge: width1600/rate1088/capacity512, suffix01, prefix rounds. Classical five-round collision literature motivates 5/6; quantum six-round results are outside this classical model.

families.label: BLAKE3
families.selection_note: Reserve two round counts and both lanes. Compression-function trails and distinguishers do not establish an ordinary unkeyed tree-hash collision boundary. Await a supported ordinary-collision pair.

families.label: Keccak[800] r544/c256
families.selection_note: The mockup supplies rate544/capacity256 but no authoritative collision frontier or domain suffix. Other Keccak[800] capacities cannot establish this pair.

families.label: Poseidon
families.selection_note: Mockup is provisional. Choose field, width, exponent, constants, sponge/compression encoding, full/partial schedule and reduction convention before selecting or executing two round counts.
